Title: Local Gentamicin Reduces Sternal Wound Infections After Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
Author: Friberg et al.
Comment: The p value was reported as an inequality (p < 0.001); the numeric p_value field stores the stated threshold 0.001, not an exact p value. The trial report calls analyses intention-to-treat, but Table 3 denominators are the 1,950 evaluable patients (967 control and 983 treatment), rather than all 2,000 preliminarily included or all 1,956 who entered the study.

domain: Cardiac surgery; prevention of sternal surgical site infection

Recruitment source: Eligible cardiac surgery patients at two Swedish cardiothoracic referral centers
Outcome measurement: All superficial sternal wound infections, defined as infection depths 1 and 2 under the study's modified CDC classification
